additional_info.subject: ID0479592-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000203] Secc is out of order CRM:03276000140
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0479592
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-
GR
SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / ND 170000203
Charger ID / Serial No.:
jenCGm
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following the client report and our checks and analysis, we can see that the error is related to RCD_FB1 or MCB_FC5 tripping. Please make sure to check carefully:
FB1 is a circuit breaker. If it trips, you need to rearm it on-site.
As for FC5, one of them must be rearmed. You need to identify which one; it is located at the bottom of the door.
Spare parts:
7KM2200-2EA40-1JA1
| -BC5 AC Meter 3P 65A Direct Modbus TCP MID |
AC Charging
5ST3010
| -FB1, -FB2, -FB3, -FC5, -FC18, -FC20, -FC21, - FC22 |
Auxiliary Switch MCB 1xNO / 1xNC
5SV3344-6KK60
-FB1 | FI/ RCD Typ A-EV 3P+N 40A 30mA + 6mA |
AC Charging
5SY4632-7
| -FC5 MCB 400V 3P+N C32 10kA |
AC Charging until early 2024
substitutes 5SV3344- 4 (RCD type B) that was used in production until mid-2023; compatible dimensions and wiring
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-GR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
.
